items.title: COP31: Can the EU turn climate ambition into delivery?
items.summary: The European Council has today (12 October) approved its main negotiating positions for the climate summit, which Climate Action Network (CAN) Europe argues is lacking a plan for "actual delivery".

items.title: Government launches flood and drought taskforce as England prepares for winter risks
items.summary: The UK Government is establishing a Flood and Drought Resilience Taskforce to improve the nation’s preparedness for extreme weather, bringing together more than 50 organisations to assess flood risks, drought response and long-term resilience.

items.title: COP17: How to bridge the gap between nature ambition and action
items.summary: From Europe's heatwaves to Nepal's floods, resilience now depends on nature.

items.title: TWO WEEKS TO GO: How AI can accelerate investment in climate solutions
items.summary: With just two weeks to go, sustainability professionals are invited to register for an upcoming edie webinar exploring how artificial intelligence (AI), market intelligence and human expertise can help businesses identify credible climate investment opportunities and secure the financial backing needed to turn sustainability ambitions into action.

items.title: WRAP launches UK textile collection and recycling programme
items.summary: WRAP has launched a programme to redesign the UK’s post-consumer textile collection system, as falling prices for used clothing and rising collection and sorting costs put pressure on the sector.

items.title: THREE WEEKS TO GO: What SMEs need to know before investing in solar
items.summary: Taking place on 5 November, this upcoming webinar will explore how SMEs can overcome the financial and practical barriers to onsite solar and maximise the return on their investment.

items.title: Innocent Drinks’ food-waste reduction initiative and Liverpool’s retrofit programme: The sustainability success stories of the week
items.summary: As part of our Mission Possible campaign, edie delivers this member-exclusive weekly round-up of five of the best sustainable business success stories of the week.

items.title: edie’s 30 Under 30: Applications close THIS FRIDAY
items.summary: There’s just a few days left to nominate for edie’s 30 Under 30 Class of 2027, an initiative that celebrates the rising stars driving meaningful change across business.

items.title: Interactive: Tracking negotiating texts at the COP17 biodiversity summit
items.summary: Next week, diplomats from around the world will descend on Yerevan, Armenia, to negotiate a series of decisions under the UN Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD).

items.title: 「我們不會離開家園」 聯合國首份海平面上升宣言保障國土淹沒後的權利
items.summary: 氣候變遷下，海平面持續上升，太平洋島國不只家園可能遭海水吞噬，甚至連整個國家都可能從地圖上消失。9月24日，聯合國大會一致通過「首份海平面上升宣言」，未來即使這些島國的國土完全遭到海水淹沒，仍可以繼續保留主權和原有海域管轄權。
